chain.title: Crafting Grid, Untethered
chain.desc: Craft from Quartz Enriched Iron, an ender pearl, a Crafting Grid and an Advanced Processor; it is a Crafting Grid you carry, so you can craft out of network storage anywhere a Wireless Transmitter reaches.

notes: Effectively a one-quest addon on 1.20.1, and reported as such rather than padded. The jar registers only two items and the second, refinedstorageaddons:creative_wireless_crafting_grid, is a creative-mode item with no recipe, so it is DROPPED. Earlier Minecraft versions of this mod also shipped a wireless fluid grid and a wireless crafting monitor; neither exists in 0.10.0. ASSUMES FROM PARENT (refinedstorage): Quartz Enriched Iron, Crafting Grid, Advanced Processor, and a Wireless Transmitter already placed and powered on the network. VERIFICATION: strict model/lang intersection gave 2 ids. The 2 model-only stems (wireless_crafting_grid_connected / _disconnected) are held-item render states, not separate items, and were correctly excluded by the intersection.
